system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files.
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the Hofund metrics and connection monitoring library codebase. Focus on subtle bugs, data integrity issues, and logic flaws detectable via static analysis. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the stale connection status bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionMeter.java where bindTo() caches the connection result once at registration (using a fixed value) so hofund_connection metrics never update after startup

Identifies the datasource de-duplication bug in hofund-spring/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/spring/datasource/DataSourceConnectionsProvider.java where connections are considered duplicates by target only, causing different datasources with the same target to be dropped

Identifies the request header handling bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/AbstractHofundBasicHttpConnection.java where setRequestHeaders() skips the first header, breaking single-header auth configurations

Identifies the version comparison boundary bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionsTable.java where checkVersions() uses <=, causing equal versions to be logged as too low

Identifies the H2 target parsing bug in hofund-spring/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/spring/datasource/h2/H2Connection.java where the target is derived using the first ':' in the JDBC URL, producing incorrect database names

Identifies the node id mismatch bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/graph/node/HofundNodeMeter.java where tagsForConnection() uses connection.getTarget() for the id instead of toTargetTag(), breaking graph alignment for DB/QUEUE connections

Identifies the HTTP version extraction bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionResult.java where http(Status, HttpURLConnection) returns UNKNOWN for UP responses without parsing the body

Identifies the unspecified-version comparison bug in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/Version.java where compareTo() returns 0 when either version is UNKNOWN or N/A, masking mismatches
